semantics.publisher_rule: Publisher identity is explicit where known.
semantics.source_rule: Repository/source revision ref is explicit where available.
semantics.build_rule: Build/export profile/tool revision is explicit where relevant.
semantics.integrity_rule: Provenance and content integrity are distinct evidence dimensions.
semantics.certification_rule: Publisher provenance does not imply certification.
semantics.license_rule: Publisher provenance does not imply recipient entitlement.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.
